record.question: The first-line pharmacological treatment for moderate to severe depression is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors (SSRIs). SSRIs are commonly recommended first-line pharmacotherapy for moderate-to-severe depression among the options; treatment choice should reflect patient history and preferences. Source/context note: Guidelines also support other antidepressant classes; “first-line” depends on patient and guideline. Reference: https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng222. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
